- `test_evicts_oldest_without_gets`: Verifies LRU eviction when capacity is exceeded without refreshing recency ✓
- `test_get_refreshes_recency`: Verifies that accessing an item refreshes its recency ✓
- `test_update_existing_key`: Verifies updating an existing key works correctly ✓

No fixes are needed as the code is already working as expected.
